offer.text: I've crossed every ridge in this world but never the fire below. Step through a portal and see the Nether for us both.

accept.text: Ha! A kindred spirit. Bring back a tale worth telling.

decline.text: Some doors are best left shut. I understand.

in_progress.text: Have you braved the portal yet?

ready.text: You walked the burning lands and returned! Quickly — tell me everything.

complete.text: Now THAT is an adventure. We'll drink to it. Take this, friend.
